outcome: Exact official first solver move; full sequence is not requested or scored in this pilot.
assistance: FEN plus piece list, legal-move choices, JSON output constrained to those choices; no engine evaluations.
baseline: Independent uniform choice among legal moves; per-puzzle success probability 1/legal_moves.
analysis: One-sided exact Poisson-binomial chance comparison per model; Holm-adjusted across three models. Exploratory, not confirmatory.
sampling: 48 puzzles: 8 per rating-stratum x one-move/multi-move cell; exclude all original 75 and all reserved 75.
predictive_split: 6 train and 2 test puzzles in each of six sampling cells, fixed before inference.
modeling_gate: At least 5 successes and 5 failures in training; then L2 logistic and shallow tree are exploratory demonstrations, not stable inference.
